title: Real-robot demonstration — deliver the ball to setpoint A
sub: Success is recorded when the basket touches the table at setpoint A.  Playback 4.6×, identical on both sides; the clock is the recorded demonstration.
steps: closes the gap, arm picks the ball up
drives to the drone's slung basket
arm drops the ball into the basket
drone lifts, basket leaves the ground
captions: On real hardware the TurtleBot must put the ball into the drone's basket.
Move-towards brings the base partway; the approach finishes inside grab.
FOLBP already holds all seven steps. PEFA is still deciding.
FOLBP: ball in the basket, handing over to the drone.
FOLBP is done — seven of seven, basket down at setpoint A.
PEFA is still carrying the ball to the basket.
Planning cost: one call against thirty-five, 8.2 seconds against 127.
